data: For fiscal 2025, which ended on September 27, 2025, Apple reported total net sales of about $416.2 billion, up roughly 6.4% from $391.0 billion in fiscal 2024. Net income was about $112.0 billion, up from $93.7 billion in fiscal 2024. That earlier figure had been held down by a one-time charge of about $10.2 billion tied to the European Commission's Irish state aid ruling. Total assets on the balance sheet at the end of fiscal 2025 were about $359.2 billion, compared with $365.0 billion a year earlier. These figures come from my recollection of Apple's fiscal 2025 Form 10-K rather than a live lookup, so please check the exact amounts against the filing if you need precision.
